mapper.sql: O.ORDERID AS orderId, O.USERID AS username, O.ORDERDATE AS orderDate, O.SHIPADDR1 AS shipAddress1, O.SHIPADDR2 AS shipAddress2, O.SHIPCITY AS shipCity, O.SHIPSTATE AS shipState, O.SHIPZIP AS shipZip, O.SHIPCOUNTRY AS shipCountry, O.BILLADDR1 AS billAddress1, O.BILLADDR2 AS billAddress2, O.BILLCITY AS billCity, O.BILLSTATE AS billState, O.BILLZIP AS billZip, O.BILLCOUNTRY AS billCountry, O.COURIER AS courier, O.TOTALPRICE AS totalPrice, O.BILLTOFIRSTNAME AS billToFirstName, O.BILLTOLASTNAME AS billToLastName, O.SHIPTOFIRSTNAME AS shipToFirstName, O.SHIPTOLASTNAME AS shipToLastName, O.CREDITCARD AS creditCard, O.EXPRDATE AS expiryDate, O.CARDTYPE AS cardType, O.LOCALE AS locale, OS.STATUS AS status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDERSTATUS OS ON OS.ORDERID = O.ORDERID ORDER BY O.ORDERDATE DESC
SELECT FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDERSTATUS OS ON OS.ORDERID = O.ORDERID WHERE OS.STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY O.ORDERDATE DESC

SELECT FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDERSTATUS OS ON OS.ORDERID = O.ORDERID WHERE CAST(O.ORDERID AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR O.USERID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY O.ORDERDATE DESC

SELECT L.ORDERID AS orderId, L.LINENUM AS lineNumber, L.ITEMID AS itemId, L.QUANTITY AS quantity, L.UNITPRICE AS unitPrice, I.PRODUCTID AS itemProductId, I.ATTR1 AS attribute1, I.ATTR2 AS attribute2, I.ATTR3 AS attribute3, P.NAME AS productName FROM LINEITEM L LEFT JOIN ITEM I ON I.ITEMID = L.ITEMID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCTID = I.PRODUCTID WHERE L.ORDERID = #{orderId} ORDER BY L.LINENUM
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERSTATUS SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ORDERID = #{orderId}
UPDATE ORDERS SET COURIER = #{courier} WHERE ORDERID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDERSTATUS OS ON OS.ORDERID = O.ORDERID ORDER BY O.ORDERDATE DESC LIMIT #{limit}
